sources.name: load
sources.cmd: F={{state}}/widgets/{{widget}}/data/board.json; if [ -s "$F" ]; then cat "$F"; else printf 'null'; fi

sources.name: save
sources.cmd: D={{state}}/widgets/{{widget}}/data; mkdir -p "$D"; T="$D/board.json.tmp"; case "$HATCH_ARG" in 'B '*) printf '%s' "${HATCH_ARG#B }" > "$T";; 'A '*) printf '%s' "${HATCH_ARG#A }" >> "$T";; C) mv "$T" "$D/board.json" || exit 1;; *) echo 'unknown save step' >&2; exit 1;; esac; printf '{"ok":true}'
